capabilities: : Compare notes and files side by side
: Edit files directly in a diff view
extras: Works locally without network requests; requires Obsidian 1.6.6 or later on desktop.
problem: Manually comparing changes between different versions of a note or merging edits from a separate draft is cumbersome.
summary: A Markdown diff viewer that allows users to compare two notes or text files side by side, highlight differences, and selectively merge changes.
